name: Phoenix metro, AZ

fields.x: lon = tile.bbox[0] + x * quantum (int, quantum 1e-5 deg); buildings sorted by y then x
fields.area: footprint area, m^2 (Overture polygon, EPSG:6933 equal-area)
fields.hs: height source: 0 unknown, 1 Overture height, 2 Overture num_floors x 3.2 m
fields.cls: Overture class, index into dicts.cls ('' = none)
fields.src: upstream dataset in Overture (OpenStreetMap / Microsoft ML / Google Open Buildings / Esri ...), index into dicts.src
fields.tracts: per tile: global tract indices into index.tracts (-1 = none)
fields.fz: FEMA NFHL flood zone at the footprint centroid, index into dicts.fz ('' = outside mapped NFHL polygons)
fields.hail: max MRMS MESH at the building pixel over hail.days, hundredths of an inch
fields.hd: 1-based index into hail.days of that max (0 = none)
fields.lst: Landsat summer land-surface temperature at the 30 m pixel holding the centroid, degC x 10; -9999 none (the pixel covers roof + yard + street; not a roof-only reading)
fields.lsc: 1-based index into lst.scenes (0 = none). Scenes differ in date/time: compare against lst.scenes[k].median_c for a heat anomaly
fields._scalar: any per-building column may be a single number when all buildings in the tile share it

tract_fields.g: 2020 census tract GEOID (11 digits; Connecticut uses 2022+ planning-region county codes)
tract_fields.geom: MultiPolygon coordinates: [polygon[ring[[lon,lat],...]]], simplified (meta.simplify_deg), rounded to meta.decimals
tract_fields.m.income: ACS B19013 median household income, USD (2024 inflation-adjusted)
tract_fields.m.home_value: ACS B25077 median value, owner-occupied units, USD
tract_fields.m.year_built: ACS B25035 median year structure built (1939 = 1939 or earlier)
tract_fields.m.owner_pct: ACS B25003 owner-occupied / occupied housing units, percent
tract_fields.m.sf_pct: ACS B25024 1-unit detached / all housing units, percent
tract_fields.m.oz18: 1 = at least half of the tract's land area lies in 2018-round Qualified Opportunity Zones (in force to 2028-12-31)
tract_fields.m.nri_flood: FEMA NRI flood risk score: max of riverine (IFLD) and coastal (CFLD) risk scores (0-100)
tract_fields.m.hpi_1y: FHFA tract HPI annual change, latest year, percent
tract_fields.m.hpi_5y: FHFA tract HPI change over 5 years to the latest year, percent

overture.name: Overture Maps Foundation buildings theme

counties.name: U.S. Census Bureau 2023 cartographic boundary counties 1:5,000,000 (cb_2023_us_county_5m)
counties.licence: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105)

tracts.name: web/usa/data/tracts/<ST>.json (Census 2020 tracts, ACS 2020-2024 5-yr, CDFI OZ 2018 & 2027, HUD QCT 2026, CDFI NMTC, FEMA NRI, FHFA tract HPI) - see that file's meta.sources
tracts.licence: US federal government works, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); HUD/FHFA not endorsing

nfhl.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer county packages (S_FLD_HAZ_AR), FEMA Map Service Center
nfhl.licence: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); FEMA: not a substitute for an official FIRM determination

mrms.name: NOAA MRMS MESH_Max_1440min (radar max estimated hail size, ~1 km), NOAA Open Data on AWS
mrms.licence: NOAA data, public domain; attribution requested

spc.name: NOAA SPC storm reports (hail) - used only to choose which MRMS days to read
spc.licence: US federal government work, public domain

landsat.name: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (ST_B10), via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC (landsat-c2-l2)
landsat.licence: US Government public domain: 'There are no restrictions on the use of Landsat products.'
landsat.citation: EROS (2020) Landsat 8-9 OLI/TIRS Level-2, Collection 2. USGS. doi:10.5066/P9OGBGM6

weather_triggers.name: web/usa/data/weather_triggers.json (NOAA NCEI Storm Events, NWS warnings via IEM, EPA AQS PM10, NOAA GHCN-Daily)
weather_triggers.licence: public domain (NOAA/NWS/EPA; IEM: 'may be used freely by anyone for any lawful purpose')
